eng: The hunters crawled close to the hole

syl: ᏃᎴ ᏗᎦᏟᏓ ᎫᎾᏗ ᏣᏚᏂᏲᎴ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᏗᎦᏘᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏰᏌᏗ
pho: nole digahltsida gv´hndi tsiduni:yo:hle sgina gó:sda:yi digálitisdóhdi gáye:sad,

syl: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏣᏓᎳᏍᏆᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏗᎦᏟᏓ ᏃᎴ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏣᏗᏥᏤᎮ
pho: aseno tsida:lsgwálisdísge digahltsida nole é:ladi daditsihe'i
eng: but the arrows broke and fell to the ground
when they hit her stony skin.
